who.title: An Empowerment-Through-Education Platform
who.paragraph: We support individuals through transitions study, work, migration, or re-setting priorities with programs and paths that are continuously updated to reflect market and community needs.

journey.title: Your Journey with EMC
journey.subtitle: From the first step to continuous growth at a clear pace without complexity.

explore.title: Explore
explore.description: Identify your need through the programs or a brief conversation.

choose.title: Choose a Path
choose.description: A course, workshop, or learning path that fits your stage.

apply.title: Learn and Apply
apply.description: Practical sessions and resources that support application, not just memorization.

grow.title: Follow Up and Grow
grow.description: Feedback and next steps within the EMC ecosystem.

visionMission.title: Vision & Mission
visionMission.subtitle: A clear vision and a practical mission: empowerment through quality education, honest guidance, and a respectful learner experience.
visionMission.visionBody: To be a trusted reference in building educational and professional paths for individuals and institutions, while preserving content quality and its human impact.
visionMission.missionBody: To deliver training and consulting programs and learning paths that help learners make clearer decisions, develop their skills, and integrate confidently into diverse environments.

roadmap.title: The EMC Roadmap
roadmap.description: Stages of developing the ecosystem with professional honesty we update priorities as we learn from the community and partners.

unify.title: Unifying the digital experience
unify.description: Connecting the catalog, registration, and follow-up in a single path the learner understands and that makes the operations team's work easier.

partnerships.title: Expanding institutional partnerships
partnerships.description: Clear agreements with universities, institutions, and trainers with documented quality and governance standards.

impact.title: Periodic impact reports
impact.description: Publishing realistic impact summaries for the community and partners, while respecting participants' privacy.

tracks.title: Developing paths across the twelve fields
tracks.description: Stronger links between fields and paths so the learner moves confidently through predictable steps.

leadership.title: A Word to the Learning Community
leadership.description: An institutional commitment to quality and transparency no fictitious names; official staffing updates are announced through approved channels.
leadership.quote: We believe good education starts with respecting the learner: clarity of expectations, content that gets updated, and a team accountable to the community. Our goal is not "biggest, fastest" but building a lasting professional Arabic reference.

differentiators.title: What Sets EMC Apart?
differentiators.subtitle: We distinguish ourselves by connecting content, guidance, and partnerships not by quick promises or false claims.

ecosystem.title: An ecosystem, not a catalog
ecosystem.description: We connect language, path, skills, and digital empowerment in a sequential, measurable experience.

audience.title: A broad audience with real needs
audience.description: Students, migrants, professionals, and growth seekers we design practical paths for them, not empty slogans.

ai.title: AI with responsibility
ai.description: We use digital tools to accelerate learning, with clear guardrails and usage ethics.

guidance.title: Practical guidance
guidance.description: Workshops, consultations, and follow-up that help you turn learning into decisions and steps.

digital.title: Education, AI, and Digital Transformation
digital.subtitle: We believe digital transformation is an opportunity for the learner when delivered in understandable language with safe tools.

points.intro: Practical introductions to AI and its everyday and professional uses.
points.skills: Digital skills that support productivity and lifelong learning.
points.safety: Principles of privacy, safety, and responsibility when using tools.
points.alignment: Linking technology to your academic or professional goals, not as an end in itself.

audience.title: Who Do We Serve?
audience.subtitle: A diverse community united around one goal: building a clearer path through quality learning.

students.title: Students and graduates
students.body: Academic planning, languages, and preparation for the next stage.

newcomers.title: Migrants and newcomers
newcomers.body: Language, professional, and community support attuned to the reality of transition.

professionals.title: Professionals and growth seekers
professionals.body: Practical skills, entrepreneurship, and responsible digital empowerment.

families.title: Families and youth
families.body: Age-appropriate programs with supervision and safe design.

organizations.body: Training workshops and partnerships with defined goals.

trainers.title: Trainers and experts
trainers.body: Content partnerships within quality and governance standards.

header.title: The Twelve Tracks
header.subtitle: EMC's official tracks one matrix uniting academic, global, digital, and professional education in a premium Arabic experience.

tracks.intro: A modern, organized tracks experience: the same twelve-part system, with cards designed for easy reading and quick access to the programs. Pick the track that starts from your current need; every card links you directly to the programs and courses catalog without leaving EMC's institutional style.

hero.title: EMC Departments
hero.subtitle: An administrative structure that ensures program quality, smooth operations, and sustainable partnerships with clear governance and professional accountability.

why.eyebrow: Why do we need specialized departments?
why.title: Organization That Serves Learning Quality
why.description: Educational programs need planning, operations, technology, and partnerships all of which require specialized teams collaborating under a unified vision.
why.body: Dividing work into departments does not mean complexity it means every decision is tied to clear accountability: from program design to participant experience, and from institutional communication to quality and compliance.

flow.title: How Do the Departments Work Together?
flow.description: An institutional collaboration model: Programs designs the content, Operations executes, Technology supports, Quality reviews and Partnerships expands the impact.

design.title: Design and approval
design.body: The Programs department builds the path, and Quality ensures compliance with standards before launch.

execute.title: Execution and experience
execute.body: Operations manages schedules and services, and Marketing delivers the message transparently.

sustain.title: Sustainability and development
sustain.body: Finance and HR support continuity, and Technology maintains security.

governance.title: Governance & Quality
governance.description: Quality and governance management is not a slogan it is a mechanism for reviewing policies, managing risks, and improving the experience based on participant and partner feedback.

points.policies: Clear policies for privacy, safety, and complaints.
points.review: Periodic review of content quality and the learning experience.
points.documentation: Documenting procedures to ensure continuity even as the team changes.
points.transparency: Transparency with partners and sponsors within ethical frameworks.

cta.title: Join the EMC Team
cta.description: If you have experience in training, operations, technology, or marketing you can have a role within one of the departments.

hero.title: Partnerships
hero.subtitle: We welcome universities, schools, companies, trainers, community initiatives, and supporting organizations on terms of clarity and a shared goal.

why.title: Why Partner with EMC?
why.description: Because we work on connecting quality education to real needs: individuals seeking a path, and institutions seeking impact within a framework of quality and respect for the learner.
why.body: We believe a successful partnership is built on defined goals, clear roles, and measurable outcomes. We do not promise "huge instant results" we commit to professionalism in design, execution, and follow-up.

benefits.title: What Do Partners Get?
benefits.description: Practical value: access to a learning community, quality execution, and a clear content identity.

items.design: Co-designing programs according to the organization's needs and target audience.
items.coordination: Operational and media coordination that maintains a professional participant experience.
items.visibility: The option to highlight the partner within ethical, transparent frameworks.
items.review: Quality review and post-delivery follow-up to improve future rounds.

process.title: The Collaboration Path
process.description: Simple steps that reduce ambiguity and speed up the start with flexibility per partner type.

initial.title: Initial contact
initial.description: We define the goal, audience, and expected timeline.

proposal.title: Proposal
proposal.description: We present a program or partnership plan with deliverables and responsibilities.

execution.title: Approval and execution
execution.description: Approving the scope of work, then operating with quality follow-up.

evaluation.title: Evaluation and improvement
evaluation.description: Participant and partner feedback enters the improvement cycle.

examples.title: Example Collaboration Opportunities
examples.description: Realistic themes that can be customized later depending on available programs and organizations.

items.university: A workshop series for university students on professional skills and specialization paths.
items.corporate: A language and orientation program for new employees within a company or institution.
items.community: A community partnership supporting a specific group through partial grants or expert volunteering.

contactBlock.title: Contact & Partnership Block
contactBlock.body: Send us your partnership idea, organization type, and target audience. We will reply with a message clarifying the potential for collaboration and the next step with no commitment before mutual agreement.

cta.title: Start the Partnership Conversation
cta.description: Contact us via the contact page and choose a partnership-related subject so your message is routed to the right team.

hero.title: Volunteering & Joining the EMC Team
hero.subtitle: An opportunity to contribute to high-quality educational programs with hands-on learning and a disciplined team experience.

impact.title: Real impact
impact.description: Contributing to learning experiences that benefit people from diverse backgrounds.

experience.title: Professional experience
experience.description: Learn how programs, operations, and quality are organized from the inside.

community.title: A supportive community
community.description: A respectful volunteering environment with clear boundaries for time and tasks.

roles.title: Roles and Areas Where You Can Contribute
roles.description: We do not promise thousands of "magical" hours we define roles tied to our departments based on the programs' actual needs.

journey.title: The Volunteer Journey
journey.description: Clear steps that reduce ambiguity and build the right commitment on both sides.

interest.title: Express interest
interest.description: Send us a brief on your experience, field, and available time with no commitment.

interview.title: Short interview
interview.description: A brief introduction session to clarify available roles and expectations on both sides.

trial.title: Structured trial
trial.description: You start with defined tasks under supervision from the Programs or Operations department.

growth.title: Evaluation and growth
growth.description: Periodic feedback to improve the experience and possibly move to a broader role.

commitment.title: Expected Commitment
commitment.description: We respect your time; that is why we ask for realistic expectations you can commit to.

lines.range: Usually between 26 hours depending on the role and stage.
lines.scheduling: Advance scheduling with room for reasonable adjustment.

lines.notice: Early notice when a conflict arises, to re-coordinate.

skills.title: Skills We Look For
skills.description: They vary by role, but these are common basics that help us work smoothly.

items.communication: Clear communication in Arabic (English is a plus when needed).
items.privacy: Respect for participants' privacy and platform policies.
items.expertise: Experience in training, editing, design, or operations depending on the role.
items.learning: A desire to learn and benefit from guidance.
items.teamwork: A collaborative spirit within a diverse team.

cta.title: Start Your Volunteering Journey with EMC
cta.description: Submit your application via the dedicated form enter your details, choose your department, and share your experience. We will review your application and contact you soon.

header.title: The Platform
header.subtitle: The EMC platform an integrated learning environment designed to help you grow with confidence and professionalism.

intro.title: Why EMC?
intro.body: The EMC platform is designed to be your companion at every step of your learning journey from choosing a program to earning your certificate and landing your opportunity. We combine academic expertise, professional training, and personal support in one integrated environment.
intro.imageAlt: The digital learning environment at EMC

hybrid.title: Flexible hybrid learning
hybrid.description: Choose between in-person attendance, remote learning, or a mix of both, according to your schedule and goals.

trainers.title: Specialized trainers
trainers.description: A team of certified trainers experienced in education, professional training, and consulting.

content.title: Continuously updated content
content.description: Curricula that keep pace with the modern job market and are updated regularly to reflect the latest professional requirements.

certificates.title: Accredited certificates
certificates.description: Earn accredited completion certificates that strengthen your professional profile and open new doors.

support.title: Ongoing follow-up and support
support.description: A system of notifications, reminders, and personal support that keeps your learning journey uninterrupted.

security.title: A safe, trusted environment
security.description: A platform protected by modern security protocols that safeguard trainees' data and privacy.

account.title: Create an account
account.description: Sign up in minutes and complete your profile to receive personalized recommendations.

choose.title: Choose your program
choose.description: Browse courses and paths and pick what fits your goal and level.

learn.description: Join your sessions, interact with the trainer, and complete your practical assignments.

certificate.title: Get your certificate
certificate.description: Complete the program and receive your accredited certificate to boost your career.
